Hi Renato, it's Dana. First, congratulations again. I was so excited on Sunday, and I'm still thrilled today. That last wave was amazing. Now, about this week. I know you're exhausted. The trip was long and tiring, so tomorrow there's no training. Just rest, go to bed early, and do some easy stretches. On Wednesday we're back in the water. On Thursday, after training, we're going to watch the replay of your heat together. It isn't boring, I promise. We can learn a lot from it. And one more thing. Everybody is going to give you a lot of attention this week. That's nice, but stay focused. The semifinal date isn't confirmed yet. The organizers might announce it this week. Okay? See you on Wednesday.

Hey everyone, it's Kai, the squad captain. A lot of you asked for this, so here's the replay of Renato's last wave in the quarterfinal. Watch the start. There's one minute left, and he's in third place. Very stressful! Then the set comes, and he doesn't hesitate. First turn, good. Second turn, better. And the third turn is the surprising one. Look at the spray! The crowd on the beach was amazed, and honestly, so was I. Some people think surf contests are boring to watch. They're not! This was the most exciting heat of the day. Okay, that's it. Like the video, and come and watch the semifinal later this month.
